name: Reputation
description: What each character thinks of the player. A reputation trait on characters, changed by the reputation action and read by the _reputation() condition. A change adds a "|name| will remember that." note under the dialogue text, and a Reputation debug tab lists every character that tracks it.
author: Nekon

min.tooltip: Lowest reputation a character can reach. Changes past it stop here.

max.tooltip: Highest reputation a character can reach. Changes past it stop here.

show_direction.tooltip: Mark the note with an up or down arrow. Off, every change reads the same "will remember that", so the player is left to guess which way it went.

character_traits.tooltip: What this character thinks of the player. Set it on a template (0 for a neutral start, below 0 for someone who starts out hostile) to track it; a character with no value is untracked until a reputation action first changes it. The plugin keeps it out of save migration, so a load never resets it to the template.
